action: Toggle Gate Playback On/Off for Selected Sample
context: Lit = plays only while pad is held; Unlit = plays full sample on tap
goal: Switch between sustaining a sample only while your finger holds the pad (Gate On) vs. triggering it with a single tap (Gate Off).
caveat: When GATE is ON and an Envelope Release is set, fade-out begins the moment you take your finger off the pad (p. 56). Also gates EXT SOURCE when held (p. 20).

citation.quote: When the [GATE] button is on, samples play back only while the pads are pressed (gate playback).

action: Toggle Loop Playback On/Off for Selected Sample
context: Repeats between Start/Loop point and End point
goal: Make a breakbeat, texture, or phrase repeat continuously between its Loop point and End point.
caveat: When GATE is off and LOOP is on, tapping the pad toggles between starting and stopping; hold HOLD + Pad to retrigger from the start without stopping (p. 21).

citation.quote: Use the loop function to make a sample play back repeatedly.

action: Toggle Reverse Playback On/Off for Selected Sample
context: Sample Mode (select pad first, or press while playing)
goal: Play a sample backwards from its End point to its Start point for reverse cymbals, vocals, or flip chops.
caveat: Where reverse playback starts when pressed mid-playback depends on the Reverse Type system setting (136) (p. 22).

citation.quote: You can use the reverse function to play back samples in reverse (from end to start).

action: Toggle BPM Sync On/Off for Selected Sample
context: Matches sample playback speed to Bank or Project tempo
goal: Automatically time-stretch a loop or chop so its tempo locks to your current Bank BPM or active Pattern BPM.
caveat: Requires accurate sample BPM data first. While BPM SYNC is ON, the manual SPEED parameter (CTRL 1 on PITCH/SPEED) is disabled (p. 20, 56).

citation.quote: The tempo of the sample then synchronizes with the bank tempo or the project tempo.

action: Trigger Note Repeat / Sample Roll (and Turn VALUE to Speed Up)
context: Hold ROLL + press up to 4 pads (or hold ROLL + turn VALUE clockwise for faster roll)
goal: Perform live hi-hat rolls, snare builds, and stutter fills—and twist VALUE clockwise while holding ROLL to accelerate the roll live.
caveat: Patterns cannot be rolled. If the roll interval is longer than the sample length, the sample loops instead (p. 23–24).

citation.quote: Hold down the [ROLL] button and press pads [1]–[16].

action: Switch Active Effect Control Between BUS 1 and BUS 2
context: Solid Orange LED = BUS 1 selected; Blinking Orange LED = BUS 2 selected
goal: Choose whether the 6 top Direct FX buttons and CTRL 1–3 knobs control your Bus 1 effect or your Bus 2 effect.
caveat: Assigning the same effect algorithm to both Bus 1 and Bus 2 shows "Same EFX on other BUS" (p. 31).

citation.quote: Press the [BUS FX] button to toggle the bus that controls the effects between BUS 1 and BUS 2.

action: Copy a Sample to Another Pad, Bank, or Project
context: Press COPY → source PAD → destination PAD (use CTRL 3 to change target Project) → COPY / VALUE
goal: Duplicate a sample onto another pad before making destructive edits or copy pads across banks and projects.
caveat: Overwrites the destination pad. Copied samples may change volume across banks due to each bank’s BANK VOLUME setting (p. 60–61).

citation.quote: Here’s how to copy the sample that’s assigned to a pad to a different pad.

action: Delete a Sample from a Pad
context: Press DEL → select PAD → press DEL or push VALUE to confirm
goal: Free up a pad in your current bank by permanently removing the sample assigned to it.
caveat: Destructive — you cannot restore a pad’s sample after it has been deleted (p. 62).

citation.quote: This is how to delete the sample assigned to a pad.

action: Toggle One-Shot Playback Mode
context: Sample selected (GATE LED will pulse)
goal: Let a long sample play all the way through without retriggering in a pattern, or prevent accidental double-triggers when finger drumming short drums.
caveat: Enabling One-Shot Playback automatically turns off LOOP for that sample (p. 21).

citation.quote: Switches the “one-shot playback” sample playback mode on/off.

action: Latch pad playback without holding it down
context: Sample Mode
goal: Keep a gated or looping sample playing hands-free without holding your finger on the pad.
caveat: Only enabled when GATE is turned ON for the pad. If LOOP is on, Hold + Pad retriggers from the start instead of stopping (p. 9, 21).

citation.quote: You can make the samples keep playing back even after you take your fingers off the pads

action: Stop all currently playing samples (Panic)
context: Or press EXIT 4 times rapidly
goal: Immediately silence long tail samples, loops, or stuck audio.

citation.quote: Stops the playback of all samples.

action: Pause / resume playing audio or pattern
context: Works in Sample Playback, Pattern Play, and TR-REC
goal: Freeze playback in place and resume from the exact same spot instead of restarting from bar 1.

citation.quote: Pauses the sample that’s currently playing back.

action: Switch between primary (A–E) and alternate (F–J) bank
context: Press the active Bank button a second time (blinks for Banks F–J)
goal: Jump between Bank A and Bank F (or B and G, etc.) with one button press.

citation.quote: Each time you press the bank [A/F] button, the bank switches between A and F.

action: Toggle Ping-Pong Looping
context: Sample selected with LOOP enabled
goal: Loop a sample forward then backward seamlessly to avoid harsh loop clicks on sustained textures.

citation.quote: Loops the sample by repeatedly playing back forward and then backward.

action: Set Roll repeat rate / time division
context: Hold ROLL + PAD to trigger roll at chosen division
goal: Change note repeat speed between 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, or triplets for hi-hat rolls and fills.

citation.quote: This shows how to set the roll interval (how fast the roll repeats).

action: View pad info and rename sample
context: Select pad first, hold/press REMAIN, then scroll down with VALUE
goal: Inspect sample details or give a pad a custom readable name on the OLED display.

citation.quote: Hold down the [REMAIN] button to show the sample parameters assigned to the currently selected pad.

action: Recall last 25–40 seconds of audio (Skip-Back Sampling)
context: When MARK button is blinking after playing audio (25s default; up to 40s with SBS Long)
goal: Capture a happy accident or jam you just played without having pressed REC beforehand.
caveat: Pressing EXIT without assigning the audio to a pad—or turning off power—permanently erases the skip-back buffer (p. 42).
steps: Press blinking MARK button to load the last 25–40s skip-back buffer
Press SUB PAD to preview; use CTRL 1 (Start) & CTRL 3 (End) to trim
Press REC → select destination PAD → press REC to save

citation.quote: You can sample what you played up to 25 seconds ago (default) using the skip-back sampling function

action: Quick-combine / bounce multiple pads together
context: Select pads to merge (Note: does not copy all individual parameters)
goal: Quickly layer a kick and snare or chord pads onto a single new pad.
caveat: Sample Merge mixes raw sample audio without Bus FX. You cannot merge samples while a pattern is playing (p. 46).

citation.quote: Switches to sample merge mode.

action: Latch Pad Mute Mode on (exit with EXIT or SHIFT + REVERSE)
context: During Pattern Playback (unmuted pads light white; muted pads turn red)
goal: Drop drum or melodic parts in and out live during a pattern—or press REC inside Pad Mute Mode to record mute automation.
caveat: Exiting Pad Mute playback with EXIT returns to normal playback (mutes stop playing back, though recorded mute motion stays in memory) (p. 79).

citation.quote: Keeps the [SHIFT] and [REVERSE] buttons in “pressed-down” state.

action: Momentary Pad Mute screen
context: Hold both SHIFT + REVERSE, tap pads to mute/unmute, release to return
goal: Quickly mute or unmute a sample in a running pattern without staying locked in Pad Mute Mode.

citation.quote: Switches the pad mute on/off.

action: Copy specific sample(s) from one pattern to another
context: While in Pattern Copy screen, press REMAIN to filter pads
goal: Create arrangement variations (e.g., copy just the kick and bass into an empty pattern).
steps: In PATTERN SELECT, press COPY, select source pattern PAD, then destination pattern PAD
Press REMAIN, then tap the specific sample PADs you want to extract (lit white)
Press REMAIN again, then press COPY or push VALUE to save

citation.quote: You can create a pattern using only specific samples that were taken from a pattern

action: Delete all notes of a specific sample from a pattern
context: In PATTERN EDIT mode (Pads with notes light up blue; confirm with VALUE)
goal: Wipe a single bad drum part or bassline from a pattern without erasing the rest of the loop.

citation.quote: While pressing the [DEL] button, press the pad (pattern) you want to delete.

action: Real-time Erase Mode while pattern is looping
context: While in Pattern Record (press DEL again to return to record)
goal: Erase only specific hits of a sound as the loop passes over them.

citation.quote: Press the [DEL] button while recording a pattern to enter erase mode

action: Bounce / convert pattern (or stems) directly to a sample pad
context: In PATTERN EDIT or PATTERN COPY menu
goal: Render a pattern—or individual stems using REMAIN—into an audio sample faster than real-time resampling.
caveat: Bouncing automatically bypasses BUS 1–4 effects and overwrites the destination pad. Use Resample if you want Bus FX printed (p. 72, 74).
steps: In PATTERN EDIT (or PATTERN SELECT), press COPY and choose the pattern to bounce
Optional: Press REMAIN and select specific pads if you only want stems
Press PATTERN SELECT to switch destination from Pattern to Sample Bank
Choose an empty destination PAD and press COPY (or push VALUE) to bounce

citation.quote: Here’s how to convert a pattern that’s assigned to a pad into a sample, and then assign that sample to a pad.

action: Toggle Rehearsal Mode during pattern recording
context: While already recording a pattern (REC LED blinks)
goal: Practice playing a part over the looping pattern without committing notes until you press REC again.

citation.quote: While you’re recording a pattern, the unit switches between rehearsal and recording mode each time you press the [REC] button.

action: Undo last pattern recording step (up to 16 steps)
context: While recording or overdubbing a pattern
goal: Revert a bad take immediately (remaining undo steps show on the left of the OLED).

citation.quote: Undoes the data you just inputted (recorded).

action: Enter Microscope Mode for step/substep note editing
context: Within TR-REC (select sample with SUB PAD + PAD, then hold PATTERN EDIT + step PAD)
goal: Inspect and nudge individual note events, micro-timing, pitch, or velocity on a specific step.

citation.quote: Press pads [1]–[16] while holding down the [PATTERN EDIT] button to select notes that are already recorded.

action: Enter TR-REC step sequencer mode
context: On Pattern Record Setting screen, press REMAIN to switch from Real-Time to TR-REC (or SHIFT + REC during playback)
goal: Program drum steps on the 16-pad grid like a classic Roland TR-808/909.
steps: Press PATTERN SELECT → REC → select empty PAD
Press REMAIN to switch to TR-REC (or press SHIFT + REC during pattern playback)
Hold SUB PAD + press a PAD to select sound without placing a step
Use VALUE encoder to switch bars; CTRL 1 for Substep type; CTRL 3 for Velocity

citation.quote: Press the [REMAIN] button, and switch the pattern recording method to “TR-REC”.

action: Record parameter motion (Substep, Velocity, Pitch) in TR-REC
context: While TR-REC pattern is running
goal: Automate pitch slides, velocity ramps, or ratchets per step in real time.

citation.quote: You can record the motion of [CTRL 1] knob in the steps.

action: Start Effects Motion Recording (FX Automation) in a pattern
context: While recording a pattern (START/END toggles Motion Play On/Off; SHIFT + MARK spot-erases motion)
goal: Automate filter sweeps, delay throws, or effect toggles directly inside a pattern loop.

citation.quote: The message “MOTION REC START” is shown (EFX MOTION REC).

action: Quantize a pattern after recording
context: In PATTERN EDIT → select pattern PAD → press RECORD SETTING → select sample PADs → push VALUE
goal: Tighten timing (Grid via CTRL 2, Strength % via CTRL 3) for specific pads in a recorded pattern.

citation.quote: You can quantize the notes of a pattern that you’ve inputted in real time.

action: Create and play a Pattern Chain (Song Mode)
context: In PATTERN SELECT, hold HOLD + press PAD to choose Chain Slot 1–16
goal: Sequence up to 16 patterns in order to build or resample/bounce a complete song arrangement.
steps: In PATTERN SELECT, hold HOLD + press a PAD to select one of 16 Chain Slots
Tap pattern PADs in the order you want them to play
Press REMAIN to toggle repeat; press SUB PAD to play chain
To bounce a chain to a pad: PATTERN SELECT → COPY → HOLD + Chain PAD → destination PAD → COPY

citation.quote: While holding down the [HOLD] button, press pads [1]–[16] to select the pattern chain number (1–16) to record.

action: Delete a pattern (or DEL + EXIT to delete all patterns in a bank)
context: In PATTERN SELECT mode
goal: Clear a single pattern pad or wipe an entire bank of patterns at once.
caveat: Destructive — deleted patterns cannot be restored with Undo. Use Bank Protect (SHIFT + COPY) to guard finished banks (p. 88).

citation.quote: Press the [VALUE] knob or [DEL] button.

action: Lock Loop Point while adjusting Start Point
context: On START/END sample edit screen
goal: Prevent the Start point from moving beyond the Loop point or End point.

citation.quote: On: Prevents the start point from being moved beyond the loop

action: Preview the last several seconds before the End point of a sample
context: On START/END sample edit screen (hold ROLL)
goal: Quickly audition and fine-tune the End point of a long sample without listening from the very beginning.

citation.quote: While this button is pressed, you can preview the sound several

context: On START/END or CHOP edit screen (enabled when RESAMPLE is lit)
goal: Eliminate clicks and pops at sample start/end/chop points by snapping markers to zero amplitude.

citation.quote: Moves the start point to the zero cross-point (*) that’s closest to the

Fine-tune markers: CTRL 3 selects mark, CTRL 2 moves selected mark, CTRL 1 places new mark
Auto Chop: Push VALUE → AUTO MARK → CTRL 2 chooses TIME DIVISION, LEVEL, or TRANSIENT

citation.quote: Splits the sample at the marker positions, and assigns the resulting

context: On START/END screen, push VALUE encoder to open menu
goal: Free up memory and normalize/chop accurately by trimming unused audio before Start and after End.

citation.quote: Trims (deletes) the sample’s audio regions before the start point and after the end point.

action: Access Groove / Humanization settings for sample
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen, press ROLL (CTRL 1 = Humanize, CTRL 2 = Rate, CTRL 3 = Groove)
goal: Add subtle timing/pitch humanization or 8-/16-beat swing templates to static loops.

citation.quote: You can add a unique rhythmic character to a sample to make it groove.

action: Adjust Pitch, Speed, Volume, or Envelope for ALL pads in current Bank
context: On PITCH/SPEED or ENVELOPE (SHIFT + PITCH/SPEED) screen
goal: Batch-edit volume, tuning, or release tails across all 16 pads in the current bank simultaneously.

citation.quote: Lets you simultaneously edit the parameters of samples that are registered to the

action: Adjust Pitch, Speed, Volume, Gate, or Loop for pads in same Mute Group
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen (Mute Group pads will flash)
goal: Change tuning, speed, or volume across all chopped slices of a sample without affecting drums in the same bank.

citation.quote: Lets you simultaneously edit the parameters of samples that are registered to the

action: Switch between VINYL Mode and VARI Mode (Backing / Ensemble)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen, hold SHIFT and turn the VALUE knob
goal: Choose classic Vinyl repitching (pitch & speed linked) or independent pitch/time-stretch (Backing for drums, Ensemble for chords/bass).
caveat: Ensemble mode consumes 2× polyphony voices for mono samples and 4× voices for stereo samples (p. 57).

citation.quote: Turns VINYL mode on/off.

action: Adjust Sample Panning or force Stereo sample to MONO (Left/Right)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen (L:50–R:50, MONO Left, or MONO Right)
goal: Pan individual drums left/right or collapse a stereo breakbeat/bass sample to mono.

citation.quote: Sets the stereo position (pan) of the sample.

action: Open Amplitude Envelope (Attack, Hold, Release) screen
context: CTRL 1 = Attack, CTRL 2 = Hold, CTRL 3 = Release
goal: Fade in a sample (Attack) or add a smooth fade-out tail (Release) so chops don't cut off abruptly.

citation.quote: Sets how the volume changes when the sample plays back.

action: Auto-detect sample BPM or manually set integer/decimal BPM (MANU / MANU-F)
context: On PITCH/SPEED screen (Turn VALUE for AUTO/MANU/MANU-F; Push VALUE on AUTO to scan BPM range)
goal: Set exact loop tempo or scan BPM within a target range so half/double-time loops sync properly.

citation.quote: Sets the sample tempo. When this is set to AUTO,

action: Flip / swap the effects assigned to Bus 1 and Bus 2
context: Anytime
goal: Instantly reverse the serial routing order of your Bus 1 and Bus 2 effects (e.g., Filter into Delay vs. Delay into Filter).

citation.quote: You can swap the effects of BUS 1 and BUS 2.

action: Toggle Master Bus 3 + Bus 4 effects on/off
context: Anytime
goal: Bypass or engage your master chain effects (like 303 Vinyl Sim + Compressor on Bus 3/4) for instant A/B comparison.

citation.quote: Temporarily bypasses BUS 3 and BUS 4.

action: Mute Bus (silence audio routed to Bus 1/2 while keeping tails/dry pads)
context: Dry pads (lit white) continue playing
goal: Drop out the main beat routed through Bus 1/2 while letting reverb/delay tails ring out or keeping a dry vocal/drum playing.

citation.quote: Temporarily turns off the audio sent to the bus

citation.quote: Saves the main parameters of the effects assigned to BUS 1 and BUS 2.

action: Lock the FX parameter screen on the OLED display
context: While in an effect menu, press REMAIN + the FX button
goal: Stop the effect parameter screen from auto-closing after a few seconds while you tweak knobs.

citation.quote: Makes the effect edit screen keep displaying.

action: Inspect or pre-tweak an effect screen without turning the effect on
context: Press REMAIN first, then the FX button
goal: Check or preset knob parameters before dropping the effect into a live performance.

citation.quote: While holding down the [REMAIN] button, press an effect button

action: Momentarily 'Grab' / punch-in an effect only while held

goal: Punch in a quick DJFX Looper stutter, Isolator cut, or Delay throw for one beat and snap right back.

citation.quote: Applies effects only while you hold down the effect buttons (EFFECT GRAB).

action: Jump directly to MFX Page 2 (17–32) or Page 3 / SFX (33+)
context: Hold MFX + DJFX LOOPER (Page 2) or ISOLATOR (Page 3), then tap PAD 1–16
goal: Select any of the 40+ MFX (including Cloud Delay, SFX Reverb, Backspin) instantly using the 16 pads without scrolling.

citation.quote: Displays the MFX LIST from #17 onwards.

goal: Balance a loud drum bank against a quiet sample bank without editing individual pads or changing master VOLUME.

citation.quote: Adjusts the volume for the specified bank overall.

action: Delete all samples (or patterns) in an entire Bank

goal: Wipe a whole bank clean in seconds instead of deleting 16 pads one by one.

citation.quote: Deletes all samples or patterns in a bank.

action: Enter DJ Mode (Dual-Deck CH1 / CH2 Performance Mixer)

steps: Press BANK D/I and BANK E/J at the same time to enter DJ Mode
Pads 1 & 5 = CH1 Pitch Bend +/- | Pads 2 & 6 = CH1 BPM +/- (Pads 3/7 & 4/8 for CH2)

action: Record & Overdub Real-Time Loops in Looper Mode
context: When MARK is switched to Looper Mode (SHIFT + Push VALUE); press RESAMPLE to toggle overdub
goal: Capture a 1-, 2-, or 4-measure layered audio loop live, adjust PLAY-RATE speed (CTRL 3) or Feedback (VALUE), and save it to a pad.
caveat: Max loop length is 16 seconds. When overdubbing, set Bus (SHIFT + CTRL 1) to LOOPER so effects are not re-applied each pass (p. 44).
steps: Press SHIFT + Push VALUE to switch MARK from Skip-Back to Looper Mode, then press MARK
Set Measures (CTRL 1), Auto Trig (CTRL 2), BPM (CTRL 3), and Bus = LOOPER (SHIFT + CTRL 1)

Press COPY → select destination PAD to save your loop to a sample pad
